# VCS / URL direct references and editable installs. The package a VCS ref
# installs is named only by its #egg= fragment; a bare archive URL names none.
requests>=2.0  # an inline comment must not be mistaken for an #egg fragment
git+https://github.com/example/foolib.git@v1.2.3#egg=foolib
-e git+https://github.com/example/barlib.git#egg=barlib
hg+https://example.org/quuxlib#egg=quuxlib
https://example.com/archives/bazlib-1.0.tar.gz
bazlib
mypkg @ git+https://github.com/example/mypkg.git
-e .
--hash=sha256:deadbeef
